data.long_meaning: The name Loshita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lohit', which means 'red'. The suffix 'ita' denotes a 'lotus'. This name symbolizes the divine union of spiritual knowledge and material prosperity, represented by the red lotus. It is also associated with the Goddess Lakshmi, who embodies wealth, fortune, and prosperity.
